title: Anthropic leaks Claude’s full system prompt for open AI use #anthropic #claudefable #aiprompts
description: Anthropic leaked a 120,000-character instruction manual for Claude, revealing over 1500 lines detailing the AI’s rules for thinking, searching, refusing tasks, and behavior. Known as the Claude Fable 5 system prompt, it is now available on GitHub for free and can be applied to other AI models. This instruction set includes extensive tool definitions, search and citation rules, and safety guidelines, offering the most comprehensive public insight into a leading AI system’s internal workings. By injecting these instructions into cheaper, open-source models like Kimi or GLM, developers can replicate Claude’s advanced operating principles. The leak highlights a major shift in AI transparency and development, enabling wider access to frontier techniques that were previously proprietary. This has significant implications for AI research, democratization of technology, and competitive dynamics across the AI market. #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #ClaudeFable5 #AIinstructions #OpenSourceAI #AImanual #ArtificialIntelligence #AIresearch #ClaudeLeak #KimiAI #GLMAI #AItransparency #AIsafety #AItools #FrontierAI
